trust_decision.summary: Whether an HTTP request that reaches the MCP SSE listener comes from a trusted local client. At the pinned commit nothing decides it: mcp-go's SSEServer.Start serves every Host/Origin with no auth. The fix adds a Host allowlist, an Origin allowlist and an optional token gate in front of the SSE handler.

landing_point.why: The summary names the MCP SSE transport. startSSE is the only place that builds and starts the SSE HTTP listener (server.NewSSEServer + sseServer.Start(addr)).

fix_sites.entry_point: MCP SSE listener (mcp-go SSEServer routes GET /sse and POST /message), started via `process-compose up` with mcp_server config (src/cmd/root.go:239-245)
MCPManager.Stop on shutdown (src/mcp/mcp_manager.go:66-71); lifecycle change needed because the listener is now an owned http.Server
every request to the SSE listener (new sseSecurityMiddleware in src/mcp/sse_security.go)
mcp_server.host / mcp_server.trusted_hosts config feeding the allowlist (trustedHosts; wildcard bind excluded)
project YAML mcp_server block (src/types/project.go:34); fix adds TrustedHosts field (fix.diff:483)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix stays inside src/mcp plus one config field in src/types/mcp.go:11-17. No second implementation, lower-level API or wrapper was changed.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the REST API route (O8): the advisory is about 'MCP tools' over the SSE transport, and the REST API is a separate, older feature with its own documented PC_API_TOKEN mechanism (src/api/routes.go:40-46), so a solver can say it is out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Loopback MCP clients (Host 127.0.0.1 / localhost / [::1], usually with no Origin) must keep working without config. A host named in mcp_server.host or trusted_hosts must be accepted. The ResponseWriter must stay an http.Flusher, or SSE streaming breaks. stdio transport is unaffected. On the REST route, the process-compose CLI/TUI client (src/client/client.go:66-83) and the WS log/state streams must keep working.

O6_input_shapes: Host as host:port, bare host, bracketed IPv6 with/without port, trailing-dot name (fix.diff:202-210)
Loopback as any 127.0.0.0/8 IP, ::1, or case-insensitive 'localhost' (fix.diff:221-227)
Origin absent vs present vs unparsable/'null' (fix.diff:153-159)
Token via X-PC-Token-Key or Authorization: Bearer with case-insensitive scheme (fix.diff:252-265)
Wildcard bind 0.0.0.0/:: is not treated as trust-all; trusted_hosts ['*'] opt-out (fix.diff:177-184, fix.diff:214-217)

O7_producer.where: src/types/mcp.go:11-17 (MCPServerConfig decoded from project YAML via src/types/project.go:34; validated at src/loader/validators.go:204-205)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The main REST API TCP listener (default localhost:8080) exposes process start/stop/restart/scale/update/project reload to the same ProjectRunner, with no Host/Origin validation. The token is optional and off by default, so DNS rebinding reaches the same process-control sink.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Advisory and fix are scoped to MCP SSE; the REST API is a separate, long-standing feature with its own token middleware.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (src/api vs src/mcp), wired separately in src/cmd/root.go:226-235

O8_uncovered_routes.route: REST routes that control processes (POST /process updates a process config, POST /process/start, /project/configuration, etc.) are gated only by the optional TokenAuthMiddleware, which uses a non-constant-time compare and has no Host check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Token auth exists, so a solver may count the route as already protected, but with no token configured nothing is checked.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/api/routes.go, another package from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: WebSocket log/state streams use a zero-value gorilla Upgrader. Its default Origin==Host check passes under DNS rebinding because the attacker origin and Host match.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Gorilla's default CheckOrigin looks like a same-origin defence already; read-only streams.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Wrap the gin router's TCP listener in the same Host/Origin gate, or plant a second MCP-over-HTTP (streamable HTTP) listener started outside the middleware.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: mcp-go also ships a streamable-HTTP server; a maintainer adding a 'streamable' transport next to SSE in startSSE's sibling would reasonably reuse server.NewStreamableHTTPServer(...).Start(addr) directly.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A transport-selection branch, e.g. an 'http' alias, that calls the library's own Start instead of s.httpServer.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Transport names are normalised in two different ways (IsSSE uses raw Transport at src/types/mcp.go:30, getTransport lowercases at src/types/mcp.go:42-47). An alias or case variant could skip the guarded path.

O9_family: Missing authentication / origin validation on a local HTTP control listener (DNS rebinding; CWE-306, CWE-346)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.26 (go.mod:3); deps incl. mark3labs/mcp-go v0.55.0, gin v1.12.0, gorilla/websocket v1.5.3; no vendor dir
O10_build.project_tests: src/mcp/control_tools_test.go, utils_test.go, argshandler_test.go exist; no SSE listener/security tests at the pinned commit (fix adds src/mcp/sse_security_test.go). Middleware is testable with httptest without network.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an Origin check or CORS restriction (WithSSECORS) only. This misses same-origin rebinding requests that carry no Origin. Or require the token only when one is set, which leaves the default unauthenticated.

out_of_scope_notes: REST TokenAuthMiddleware compares tokens with != rather than constant-time (src/api/routes.go:19); timing side-channel, separate concern.
MCP tool processes substitute user arguments into commands (src/mcp/argshandler.go); command-injection surface not examined.
